newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SCMB Barnes resigns, joins Capital Alliance.
newsitem.headline: SCMB Barnes resigns, joins Capital Alliance.

text.p: Standard Corporate and Merchant Bank (SCMB) said on Wednesday its deputy managing director and head of treasury Mark Barnes had resigned in order to become chief executive of Capital Alliance Financial Services Group.
Barnes had been at SCMB, part of Standard Bank Investment Corp Ltd, for 12 years in which he had played a major role in the creation of the unit.
SCMB managing director Jacko Maree said Barnes' resignation would not hit client relationships as employees working under him had independent responsibility for their operations' risk management.
"A senior management reporting structure is in place and there should be no adverse impact on client relationships," Maree said.
Barnes said he wanted to pursue the challenge of heading a new financial services group and left SCMB "with regret".
